claim: loss(w,t) = c_t + g(w) * a_t + h(w) * b_t + noise, where g and h are two shared linear directions in mixture coordinates and a_t and b_t are task scalars

randomness.seed_rule: little-endian uint64 from first 8 bytes SHA256('TWODIAL-E2E-V1:' + label)

coordinates.name: zero-safe Hellinger
coordinates.reason: supports structural zeros without an outcome-dependent replacement constant

R1.response: lower-is-better losses; log(perplexity) for DataDecide; within-fold task centering and scaling with ddof=1
R1.folds: SHA256 row ID modulo 5; Olmix and RegMix hold out mixture rows; DataDecide holds out recipe-model cells and keeps all seeds of a cell in one fold

estimators.rank_constrained: OLS with intercept followed by SVD truncation of the coordinate-by-task slope operator; ranks 1 through 6
estimators.nonparametric: ExtraTreesRegressor with 500 trees, min_samples_leaf=2, max_features=1.0, deterministic protocol seed

R1.datadecide_design: recipe one-hot, centered log non-embedding parameter count, and their interactions; recipe and model are parsed by the official right-split convention
R1.noise_floor: median across tasks and recipe-model cells of the seed standard error of task-standardized final-step log(perplexity), requiring at least 2 seeds per cell
R1.metric: root mean squared task-standardized heldout error pooled over folds; source summary is the median over its released tables or scale blocks
R1.source_vote: rank2 passes a source only if all three inequalities pass; rank2-sufficient requires at least 2 of 3 source votes; rank1-sufficient requires rank1 within 0.5 sigma of best baseline in at least 2 sources; otherwise rank3+-sufficient
R1.arm_selection_source: RegMix 1M train tables with its released test-mixture rows as the frozen candidate set

training_stack.optimizer: AdamW, learning_rate=0.0004, min_lr=0.00001, betas=[0.9,0.95], weight_decay=0.1, grad_clip=1.0

R2.rocm_compatibility_scope: Glue may replace unavailable NVIDIA fused RMSNorm, rotary embedding, SwiGLU, and cross entropy with mathematically equivalent PyTorch native operations; disable WandB; emit JSON. No model, sampler, optimizer, schedule, mixture, or evaluation change is allowed.

arms.rank_selected: Candidate mixture minimizing the mean standardized validation loss predicted by the R1 selected-rank RegMix estimator
arms.full_nonparametric: Candidate mixture minimizing the mean standardized validation loss predicted by the frozen R1 ExtraTrees estimator
arms.h_probe: Orient RegMix rank-2 h so mean(code, math) task loading minus mean(Pile-CC, Wikipedia) is positive; among released candidate rows with L1 distance from rank_selected in [0.20,0.60], choose the maximum h score; if empty choose the candidate with maximum h score among rows at L1 distance at least 0.20

evaluation.primary: mean of task-standardized validation cross entropy using pooled seed mean and standard deviation
evaluation.bpb: cross entropy divided by log(2), reported per task

R2.power_rule: After the first 12 completed jobs, estimate paired-seed sigma for every arm contrast. If the absolute low-rank versus full contrast and its 95% interval are both below 0.5 sigma but directionality is unresolved, run a second point using tinyllama_60M or 2x tokens for rank_selected, full_nonparametric, and h_probe with 3 paired seeds; choose the smaller predicted completion time from a fresh Slurm probe.

scientific_verdict.supported: At least 10 jobs complete; every arm has at least 2 seeds; rank_selected aggregate loss minus full_nonparametric is at most 0.5 paired sigma; rank_selected beats official_regmix by at least 1.0 paired sigma; observed rank_selected-to-h_probe task-effect vector has cosine at least 0.70 with its frozen prediction and sign agreement at least 10 of 13 tasks; mean(code,math) and mean(Pile-CC,Wikipedia) changes have opposite signs and each magnitude is at least 1.0 paired sigma.
scientific_verdict.falsified: Completion gate passes and rank_selected is worse than full_nonparametric by more than 1.0 paired sigma, or direction cosine is below 0, or sign agreement is at most 6 of 13 tasks.
scientific_verdict.inconclusive: Completion gate passes but neither supported nor falsified rule passes.
scientific_verdict.incomplete: Fewer than 10 jobs produce all 13 validation losses after automatic retries.

retry.missing_policy: After 3 failed attempts mark missing and continue; do not reduce tokens, model, tasks, or seeds.
